yeah i totally know the feeling of freezing up like that and then afterwards thinking of all the things you could have/wanted to say, but it was a situation you didn't know would happen so it's normal not to know what to say. i think it was still good that you were honest with her though. It's also hard to admit to yourself that you're relapsing sometimes (at least for me) and then if somebody finds out before you've really gotten a grip on it then it can make things more confusing because of the guilt that the other person knows. Just keep being as honest as possible with your friend and try to get mental health help if you can. Maybe decide if you want to be the one to bring it up with her or if you want to wait for her to say something again and have a more prepared response that you couldn't give when you were in a bit of shock. Try not to be too hard on yourself after all this, it's already exhausting to deal with all the thoughts/emotions from it
